concepts.title: 女の子① 赤い栞の記録士
concepts.brief: 明快で親しみやすい主人公候補。短い白銀髪、赤い栞リボン、短いケープ。
concepts.design: FEMALE concept A, a bright courageous novice chronicler. Chin-length silver-white bob with one short side braid, expressive turquoise eyes, warm determined half-smile. Recognizable compact silhouette: cropped ivory capelet with crimson inner lining over fitted NAVY high-neck tunic, ivory asymmetric knee-length pleated overskirt over opaque navy leggings, practical white ankle boots. One long flat crimson bookmark ribbon from left shoulder to waist, geometric silver eye clasp, small cyan crystal at belt. Holds a closed slim navy chronicle at her left side; right hand relaxed slightly outward with a single card between fingers. Avoid long hair, tall hats or huge robes. The red ribbon and bob are her identity.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE polished full-body CHARACTER DESIGN concept image for LORE, an original magical-library duel card game.
Portrait 2:3 canvas. ONE character only, full body head to boots completely visible with margins, standing relaxed in a slight three-quarter view toward the viewer, clear face and hands, comparable character scale across the set. No extra face panels, no turnaround sheet, no duplicate figures, no typography or wordmark.
Reference image 1: approved LORE world key visual, for white/silver clothing, midnight navy shadows, cyan Attune crystals, restrained crimson accents and arcane library aesthetic. This is a WORLD/STYLE reference, not a requirement to copy its two men or seated pose. Reference image 2: current LORE logo, for clean sharp silver-white facets, cyan edge and eye/compass-ring motif. One small original eye/compass clasp is enough; do not repeat eye symbols all over.
Style: Genshin Impact and Honkai: Star Rail-like premium anime RPG character design appeal, beautiful expressive face, sophisticated but readable layered clothing, crisp silhouette, confident cel-painted shading with painterly finish. Entirely ORIGINAL character, do not copy a named franchise character or distinctive outfit. Magical archivist fantasy, not space soldier or modern streetwear. Young ADULT approximately 20-25. Stylish, capable, inviting. Practical nonsexual clothing.
Unifying palette: dominant ivory/white and navy, silver metal, localized cyan crystal light, restrained crimson. No ornate gold overload. Complexity medium-low: 3 major garment masses, 1 signature accessory, 1 readable book/card motif; avoid dozens of tiny straps, chains, jewels and brooches. Hair, arms, coat panels and prop should have clean separable silhouettes suitable for later 2D animation. Face and chest must remain distinctive at cropped waist-up game leader scale.
Pose: mild confident breathing-ready neutral stance, arms separated slightly from torso, clear hand shapes, prop at hip or outward to one side not covering face/chest. No attack VFX, no huge floating objects. Normal anatomy.
Background: identical restrained midnight navy to blue-gray studio-like gradient with only very faint blurred white archive arches behind; quiet floor shadow, no furniture or narrative scene. Cool clean rim light and soft neutral facial light so white clothing and silhouette read clearly. The character is the focus, occupies 85% image height. Not transparent and not an animation-ready rig; this is a finished concept illustration.

concepts.title: 女の子② 第零書庫の封印官
concepts.brief: 静かで凛とした上級司書。長い紺髪と直線的な白いロングコート。
concepts.design: FEMALE concept B, a composed enigmatic keeper of the Zero Archive. Long straight midnight-blue hair to lower back with a single broad ivory streak at the right temple, blunt tidy bangs swept to one side, pale ice-blue eyes and quiet self-possessed expression. Tall elegant column silhouette: structured ivory long coat with clean angular split tails, navy high-neck inner dress ending below knees, opaque dark tights and simple silver-trimmed boots. Sleeves are fitted enough that hands remain visible. One small crimson wax-seal tie at chest; signature palm-sized silver eye/compass ring suspended beside an open hand, with a small cyan crystal at its center. Other hand rests on a closed ivory sealed book at hip. Crisp geometry, minimal ornament, no crown, no witch hat, no giant staff. Strongly different from a short-haired energetic apprentice.

concepts.title: 女の子③ 回覧車の交渉人
concepts.brief: 快活で駆け引き上手。栗色の高いポニーテール、軽装、カードケース。
concepts.design: FEMALE concept C, a witty outgoing archive circulation dealer who excels at choosing and trading histories. Warm chestnut high ponytail with a broad navy tie, loose asymmetric side fringe, amber eyes, lively clever smile. Agile compact silhouette: asymmetrical ivory waist-length scholar jacket with one short shoulder cape on the left, navy high-waist tailored trousers tapering to calf, clean white mid-calf boots; a restrained crimson waist sash. Signature rectangular silver-and-navy book/card case on belt shaped like a tiny circulation carriage drawer, one cyan square crystal latch. Right hand playfully presents a small fan of three distinct cards to her side, left hand relaxed near the case. No big floating cards. Clearly scholarly fantasy rather than a casino dealer uniform, no bunny motifs or revealing costume.

concepts.title: 男の子① 蒼の対読士
concepts.brief: 採用KVの青側を発展。黒紺髪、白い肩掛け、落ち着いた戦略家。
concepts.design: MALE concept A, a thoughtful reliable young adult duel scholar, developing the dark-haired blue-cloaked man in reference 1 into a clear protagonist design. Tousled short midnight-black hair with cool blue sheen, focused cobalt-blue eyes, calm confident expression. Ivory tailored scholar coat reaching just above knees, navy vest and high collar, simple slim navy trousers, white-and-navy boots. One asymmetric white half-cape across left shoulder, deep cobalt lining, one tiny crimson bookmark tie. Clean silver eye clasp at chest and small cyan Attune crystal at belt. Holds a slim open book in left hand out to the side, right hand loosely holds one card at waist. Readable triangular upper silhouette and open lower coat split, no giant armor, no excessive belts or medals.

concepts.title: 男の子② 紅の封緘士
concepts.brief: 採用KVの赤側を発展。白銀髪、深紅の裏地、余裕のある好敵手。
concepts.design: MALE concept B, an elegant slightly mischievous young adult rival and curator of sealed chronicles, developing the silver-haired red-cloaked man in reference 1. Soft wavy silver-white hair in a longer swept fringe and short nape, garnet-red eyes, a restrained knowing smile. Crisp white high-collared waistcoat over navy shirt, elegant ivory long split-tail coat with deep crimson lining, narrow navy trousers, knee-high navy boots with minimal silver edges. Strong long-coat silhouette with one broad crimson inner panel, not the short half-cape of concept A. Signature narrow red seal ribbon wrapped once around a slim white chronicle held at his side, silver angular eye clasp on belt and small cyan crystal. Free hand slightly raised as if ready to slide a card across a table. Elegant, mature, fully clothed, no crown, no sword, no giant ornamental pauldrons.

concepts.title: 男の子③ アチューンの調律師
concepts.brief: 親しみやすい技巧派。赤茶の短髪、短い白ジャケット、結晶の調律道具。
concepts.design: MALE concept C, an inventive warm-hearted young adult maintainer of Attune crystals and the circulation mechanism. Short unruly copper-auburn hair, round lively teal eyes, friendly confident grin. Athletic practical silhouette: cropped ivory utility scholar jacket with broad navy cuffs, navy fitted high-neck top, ivory-to-navy color-block tailored trousers and practical white lace-up boots. A single short crimson scarf tied close to neck, no long coat or cape. Signature small SILVER tuning-fork-like archive instrument with a cyan crystal set between the prongs, held casually down and outward in right hand; a slim navy bound notebook in left. One clean rectangular book pouch at hip. This is refined magical library engineering not steampunk: no brown leather overload, brass gears, goggles or firearms. Angular silver finish matching LORE logo.
